newsitem.title: NORWAY: POLL - Update of Norwegian election surveys.
newsitem.headline: POLL - Update of Norwegian election surveys.

text.p: The latest opinion poll released ahead of the September 15 Norwegian election showed the ruling Labour (LP) minority government continuing to lose ground while the far-right Progress Party (PP) gains support compared with the 1993 election.
Projected percentage for each party (figures are rounded)

Org sample poll date LP PP H CPP CP V SL RE others

NOTE -- Labour Party (LP), Progress Party (PP), Conservatives (C), Christian People's Party (CPP), Centre Party (CP), Liberal Venstre (V), Socialist Left Party (SL) Red Election Alliance (RE). Norwegians will elect a new 165-seat parliament. The Labour Party, which has been in power since 1990, tends to rule alone, finding support on a case-by-case basis from several parties in parliament. The three centrist parties, the Centre Party, the Christian People's Party and the liberal Venstre, want to form a coalition government.
